column1: # Instruction patches for Syphon Filter: Dark Mirror (UCES-00310): address, original, new.
# Frame pacing: the main loop thread sleeps until the vblank interrupt wakes it (handler
# 0x08c193dc: sceKernelWakeupThread), then the frame limiter (0x08c2275c) waits one more vblank
# whenever 1e6 / frame time exceeds the target at object+484. Two vblanks per frame: 30 fps.
# The logic runs on the measured frame time (0x08c20914), so the port skips the limiter's wait
# ("bc1t" -> "b") and the vblank wake-up alone paces the game: 60 fps. The PC 30 fps setting
# (config.ini [video] frame_rate) still works in the runtime.
